ui_bugs.issue: After clicking Clear All and then ticking 2 GPs the label reads '17 of 19 selected' and the Monthly Matrix shows 18 rows, instead of the required '2 of 19 selected' with only those 2 rows. Root cause in /app/frontend/src/components/GrowthPartnerFilter.js `toggle()`: when `selected` is empty (Clear All state) it falls back to `base = allIds`, so every checkbox appears already checked and clicking one REMOVES it instead of adding. The `effective` value used to render `checked={effective.includes(p.id)}` uses the same `selected.length ? selected : allIds` fallback, so the UI cannot distinguish 'default = all' from 'explicitly cleared = none'. Fix suggestion: represent 'all' as a sentinel (e.g. `selected=null` for default and `[]` for explicitly cleared), or gate the fallback in `toggle` on an `isDefault` flag - so that after Clear All, ticking an option produces `[id]` (i.e. '1 of 19 selected'). Default state (no Clear All) still works correctly because users are not expected to un-tick every partner manually.

action_items: Fix GrowthPartnerFilter multi-select toggle so that after Clear All, ticking N options yields 'N of 19 selected' (and drives the matrix to those N rows). Same fix applies to leave-monthly-gp-filter and leave-all-gp-filter which share the component.
critical_code_review_comments: GrowthPartnerFilter conflates 'default (all)' and 'cleared (none)' as the same empty array, so Clear All + individual ticks becomes an unusable 'un-tick everything else' workflow.

Mobile search inside the filter requires a digit in the term (`/\d/.test(term)` guard); a purely alphabetic query never triggers the mobile branch. That's correct today, but note the operator precedence: `String(p.mobile).includes(digits) && /\d/.test(term)` - keep the parentheses explicit for clarity.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All GP-scoping counts are now correctly 19 across Attendance (Total tile) and Leave (Monthly and All Employees). Filter/search/print testids are wired everywhere. The only real defect is the Clear-All + tick-N behaviour of GrowthPartnerFilter multi-mode; single-mode (Call Log) is unaffected. window.print stub pattern (add_init_script('window.print = () => { window.__printCalled = (window.__printCalled||0) + 1; };')) worked cleanly for all three print buttons.
rca of the issue: GrowthPartnerFilter uses selected=[] to mean 'all selected' AND as the target of Clear All. toggle() falls back to allIds when selected is empty, so a click on a checkbox that appears checked (because effective=allIds) subtracts that id from allIds instead of appending to an empty selection. UX-level fix: make Clear All set an explicit empty-state marker distinct from default, or make toggle() branch: `if (!selected.length) onChange([id])` else the current behaviour.
